CustomField.description: Tenant has gone quiet: active, in an outreach stage, and more than 14 days since last contact. The 14-day threshold is a working assumption — change it here only.
CustomField.formula: AND(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Active"), OR(ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Notice Sent"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Awaiting Tenant Response"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Negotiating")), NOT(ISBLANK(Last_Contact_Date__c)), (TODAY() - Last_Contact_Date__c) > 14)
CustomField.label: Non-Responsive
